notes.title: 🎮 Popit Game Update — Fixes Loaded, Let’s Play
notes.notes:
Smarter, smoother, and more stable gameplay starts today




We’re continuously improving Popit Game to make your play smoother and more fun — and Update 1.0.14 brings several important fixes:




🧩 Changelog Highlights:

— Fixed a softlock bug triggered by attacking Popits

— Fixed real-time block update issues

— Improved font rendering in invoices and screens

— Improved spectator mode for better viewing performance




Your feedback is what makes Popit Game better with every patch — keep it coming!




With love,

GOSH Team

notes.title: ⭐️ Popit Game Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Here’s what’s new in this version:




🃏 Deck Screen Fixed

Fixed an issue where the full deck screen didn’t properly update after deck changes  — causing deleted or replaced cards to still appear visually.




🎮 Out of Cards = Game Over

From now on, if you discard or delete all your cards and the deck is empty — it’s game over.




👁 Spectator Mode Fixed on Android

You can now enjoy watching other players more smoothly.




📱 Scroll Shaking Reduced

We’ve fixed scroll behavior to make navigation more comfortable.




 🎯 Popits Display Bug Fixed

Popits from the previous opponent’s hand are now displayed correctly when reviewing past rounds — no more confusion during game analysis.




🛠 More Bug Fixes

Several other bugs and minor issues have also been resolved to make the game run better and smoother.





We listen to every report and suggestion

Thank you for helping us make Popit Game better with each update!

notes.title: New Update is Here 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello! 
 
What’s New? Changelog for the last two versions of Popit Game: 

Devs made lots of changes. You've already experienced many of them in-game — but here's a full summary:

🔧 Popit Changes:




Removed Entropy Effects from the following Popits:





🎮 Turn the first card to ♠️ in Layout

🎮 Turn the first card to ♥️ in Layout

🎮 Turn the first card to ♣️ in Layout

🎮 Turn the first card to ♦️ in Layout

🎮 Convert a card to the left of the last card in Layout into the same last card

🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♠️ card in Deck

🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♥️ card in Deck

🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♣️ card in Deck

🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♦️ card in Deck





Following Popits' values have been changed:





🃏 Every scored card permanently gets x value

🃏 Permanently upgrade the value of the first card in layout by x. Score next time

🃏 Permanently Mult value of the first card in layout by x. Score next time




Following Popits now add a percentage to the score for each card.

Also, the chances to get them in the shop are reduced:





🔥 Each card added to Deck adds x% to score

🔥 Each destroyed Face card adds x% to score

🔥 Popits with Corruption effect give +x Mult each

🔥 Each card missing from Deck’s original size adds x% to score

🔥 Add 20% of the sell value of all Popits to your Mult





Following Popits' chances to appear in the shop were reduced:





🌟 Each scored Ace,2,3,5,8 add x Mult

🌟 First Face in Layout card give x Mult

🌟 Scored 10 or 4 give +10 Score & +4 Mult Each

🌟 Retrigger first scored card (×) times

🌟 Scored ♠️ +x Score





Following Popits' scores have changed, and their chances to appear in the shop were reduced:





⚡️ Each Acki Nacki Popit gives +x Mult

⚡️ Scored ♣️ +x Mult

⚡️ Earn $ x% of the Credits in your wallet per Block





(!) Popit cost has been changed.

Previously, each Popit cost 6 Shells.

Now, the price depends on the Entropy Effect:

6 for a Popit without an Entropy Effect,

10 for Aberration,

20 for Mutation,

34 for Distortion,

and 62 for Corruption.





😈 Overdraft Fees calculation has been reworked. Now, under heavy overdraft, Overdraft Fees increase more sharply.




Look around — someone might be planning to attack you right now...



Follow Our Official Telegram Channel for more info: 

https://t.me/ackinackinews







With love,

GOSH team

notes.title: We Have Great News! New Update Is Live ⭐️
notes.notes:
Hello! We have a $500,000 prize pool — and the top 10,000 winners will receive a prize in our Popit Games Tournament! 

And we keep updating the game for your best experience:


🏆 Leaderboard Updated

Yep — it’s now crystal clear who’s winning what.

You can instantly see your position and the prize you’re aiming for.

(We also added some nice music to spice it up)




🔥 Top 50% Now Displayed Accurately

No more guessing — you will see whether you’re safe or on the edge, in real time.




👅 Localization Added

We’ve added languages for your convenience (and will add more in the future):

English 🇬🇧 French 🇫🇷 Catalan 🇪🇸 Portuguese 🇵🇹 Spanish 🇪🇸 Italian 🇮🇹Russian 🇷🇺Ukrainian 🇺🇦Polish 🇵🇱Arabic 🇸🇦Farsi (Persian) 🇮🇷Indonesian 🇮🇩Turkish 🇹🇷Malayalam 🇮🇳Chinese 🇨🇳Japanese 🇯🇵Korean 🇰🇷




🤺 New Attacking Popits

You will see more attacking Popits now — and two new ones have joined the tournament:

• A Popit that reduces your opponent’s hand

• A Popit that shrinks their discards




🎮 Gameplay Improvements

We’ve squashed bugs and smoothed things out for a better experience overall
